blurb: Guests can visit the tasting room for wine by the glass, flights, or bottles, and enjoy small bites with local meats, cheeses, crackers, and pâtés. The winery produces limited, high-quality whites, rosé, and light reds that reflect the maritime climate and terroir of Pender Island. Group reservations are available for tastings with a minimum of 8 people and a maximum of 12 people per group.
extraNote: Wine orders require signature of sober adult 19+ upon delivery · No outside food allowed on premises · Groups limited to 90 minutes tasting time · Tasting room patio and lounge at 6621 Harbour Hill, Pender Island
